full_judgment: 2. Facts, relevant for disposal of the Rule, in short, are that, one Md Nazrul Islam, as petitioner (plaintiff), had filed Pre-emption Miscellaneous Cise No.47 of 1983, on 10-5-1983, before the court of the then Munsif, Joypurhat, Bogura (now Senior Assistant Judge, Joypurhat), under the provision of section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act (SAT), 1950, against Md Majibur Rahman and others, seeking right of pre-emption in respect of the suit property mentioned in the schedule to the petition for pre-emption. The contention of the pre-emptor is that, he is the co-sharer by inheritance and the opposite parties No. 1-4 are strangers in the suit property and that the transfer deed No. 4932 dated 21-4-1983 was executed by pre-emptee No. 5 (seller) in favour of the pre-emptee opposite parties No. 1- 4 (purchasers), without their knowledge and, that, since he is co-sharer in the suit property, therefore, he is entitled to a decree for pre-emption as prayed for.
